SELECT DISTINCT  ?v0
WHERE
  { FILTER(true) .
  ?v1  ?v2        dbpr:Pharmaceutical_industry ;
              rdfs:label     ?v0 ;
              dbpo:abstract  ?v3
    FILTER langMatches(lang(?v0), "en")
    FILTER langMatches(lang(?v3), "en")
  }
